GMS-GOV-001.finding: Architecture is well documented, but the security-specific trust-boundary/data-flow inventory is not yet maintained as a single release artifact.
GMS-GOV-001.remediation: Create security threat model/data-flow map and keep it synchronized with production components.

GMS-GOV-002.finding: Sensitive student/source/AI data exists, but a complete retention/provider/deletion classification is not yet implemented and verified.
GMS-GOV-002.remediation: Create data classification register and end-to-end lifecycle tests.

GMS-AUTH-001.finding: Auth helpers and protected app routes exist. Live 2026-10-07: Supabase anonymous sign-ins are enabled (52 of 54 users anonymous); anonymous sessions carried the authenticated role. Now treated as signed out by middleware/getUser/requireUser/requireApiUser, and restrictive RLS blocks anonymous inserts. Route-by-route unauthenticated API verification still required.
GMS-AUTH-001.remediation: Disable anonymous sign-ins in Supabase Auth; decide on purging existing anonymous users/data; generate endpoint inventory and add unauthenticated negative tests for every private API.
GMS-AUTH-001.notes: Anonymous-session boundary fixed in code on security/audit-checklist; dashboard toggle pending. See implementation/SECURITY_AUDIT_CHECKLIST.md.

GMS-AUTH-002.finding: OAuth callback uses Supabase code exchange and safeNext validates same-origin paths; full provider state/PKCE and preview/production callback testing remains open.
GMS-AUTH-002.remediation: Add OAuth integration tests for state/PKCE, encoded redirects and callback allowlists.

GMS-ACCESS-001.finding: RLS and room-scoped access are core architecture and DB security tests exist, but a complete API object-substitution matrix has not been executed.
GMS-ACCESS-001.remediation: Build BOLA/IDOR matrix for every route/resource and add foreign-ID tests.

GMS-ACCESS-002.finding: Service-role operations are intentionally server-only and many paths scope owner IDs, but service-role usage is broad enough to require a complete privileged-call inventory and negative audit.
GMS-ACCESS-002.remediation: Inventory every createServiceSupabaseClient call; require user/room/object scope and tests or owner-scoped RPC helper.

GMS-ACCESS-003.finding: Optional Python retrieval service exposes index/search/flashcards/delete operations using supplied room IDs without an authenticated Studigo principal.
GMS-ACCESS-003.remediation: Keep service loopback/private-only or add service authentication plus caller/room authorization and network restrictions before any public deployment.
GMS-ACCESS-003.notes: Current docs already state it is not an approved production private-retrieval boundary.

GMS-API-001.finding: Many routes enforce UUID/length/enum limits, but validation is not yet verified consistently across the full API surface.
GMS-API-001.remediation: Add route inventory and schema/fuzz tests; centralize validation where practical.

GMS-API-002.finding: No centralized public rate/concurrency/spend guardrail was found for model, OCR, embedding and other expensive operations.
GMS-API-002.remediation: Implement per-user/IP rate limits, concurrent-operation caps, token/work budgets, daily spend ceilings and a global provider circuit breaker.
GMS-API-002.notes: Account minting via anonymous sign-ins is closed in code (GMS-AUTH-001). Vercel firewall config for studigo-ai does not exist (API 404, 2026-10-07): no WAF rate-limit rules. No max_output_tokens on any Responses call; /api/documents/reindex resets attempts with no cooldown. See implementation/SECURITY_AUDIT_CHECKLIST.md.

GMS-API-003.finding: Local beta and waitlist have provenance/origin protections, but no universal production mutation control was verified across cookie-authenticated APIs.
GMS-API-003.remediation: Implement/verify centralized Origin/CSRF policy and cross-site negative browser tests.

GMS-API-004.finding: detail: error.message removed from upload, document delete, chat, quiz and flashcards routes. /api/chat still streams thrown error.message in SSE error events, and signUpAction returns Supabase error text.
GMS-API-004.remediation: Map streamed and auth errors to fixed learner-facing strings; add a central error mapper with trace IDs.

GMS-WEB-001.finding: next.config.ts now sends an enforced CSP subset (frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'), X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and a full CSP as Report-Only. Verified on a local production build; production deploy not yet verified.
GMS-WEB-001.remediation: Browser pass on the Report-Only policy, then enforce the full CSP (nonce-based if inline scripts must go); verify deployed headers.

GMS-WEB-002.finding: Production rich-text parser explicitly avoids HTML injection, but adversarial XSS/output-handling tests are not yet a release gate.
GMS-WEB-002.remediation: Add model/source/user payload tests for script tags, javascript/data URLs, image beacons and malicious Markdown.

GMS-FILE-001.finding: Upload allowlist, 50MB size limit and filename sanitization exist.
GMS-FILE-001.remediation: Add complete adversarial upload tests and verify all upload entry points share the same policy.

GMS-FILE-002.finding: assertContentMatchesType checks bytes for every allowed format (PDF header, PNG/JPEG/WEBP signatures, OOXML ZIP with the expected main part, UTF-8 text without NUL) before storage. Polyglot detection (e.g. PDF+HTML) is not implemented.
GMS-FILE-002.remediation: Add polyglot rejection, or re-serve originals only with a forced download Content-Disposition and nosniff.

GMS-FILE-003.finding: OCR page and chunk limits exist. assertSafeZip now rejects OOXML archives over 5000 parts, 300 MB declared expansion or 100x ratio, at upload and before extraction. Central-directory sizes can be understated by a crafted archive; image pixel/dimension limits, PDF object-stream bombs and parser time/memory budgets are still missing.
GMS-FILE-003.remediation: Add pre-extraction archive expansion/file-count limits, image dimension limits, parser time/work limits and bomb fixtures.

GMS-FILE-004.finding: Architecture documentation identifies malware scanning as a public-launch requirement; implementation was not found.
GMS-FILE-004.remediation: Add quarantine + malware scanning or define an equivalent accepted-risk isolation model before public uploads.

GMS-FILE-005.finding: Files are private and signed download URLs are generated only after user-scoped document lookup, but foreign-file and URL-expiry tests should be explicit release evidence.
GMS-FILE-005.remediation: Add cross-user signed-download and replay/expiry tests.

GMS-AI-001.finding: Uploaded source material is serialized as untrusted. Fixed 2026-10-07: model-extracted topic titles and earlier model-written practice questions entered system prompts as raw directive text, and /api/chat appended browser-supplied directive text to the system prompt; both now go through the untrusted-data envelope or are ignored. Full multimodal/indirect verification through production paths is still pending.
GMS-AI-001.remediation: Run text/metadata/OCR-image indirect injection corpus through actual production paths.

GMS-AI-002.finding: Adversarial RAG fixtures are designed, but the human-reviewed live production scorecard is not complete.
GMS-AI-002.remediation: Complete reviewed live eval and make injection failures release-blocking.

GMS-AI-003.finding: Machine-affecting model outputs use structured schemas and normalization in core study/grading paths.
GMS-AI-003.remediation: Keep schema/normalizer regression coverage whenever contracts change.

GMS-AI-005.finding: Cross-room/user decoys and untrusted-source tests exist in the RAG evaluation design; live reviewed evidence is incomplete.
GMS-AI-005.remediation: Complete live reviewed disclosure/isolation eval and add system-prompt/secret extraction cases.

GMS-AI-006.finding: Adaptive challenge records already include generator/evaluator/source version concepts, but model/prompt/retrieval version tracing is not yet universal.
GMS-AI-006.remediation: Adopt one AI trace/version envelope across all provider calls.

GMS-AI-007.finding: Evaluation schemas contemplate latency/cost, but production-wide token/cost/latency observability and budgets are not implemented.
GMS-AI-007.remediation: Add privacy-conscious AI tracing and operation/user/global budgets.

GMS-RAG-001.finding: Canonical TypeScript retrieval is room-scoped under caller RLS; complete live cross-tenant reviewed verification is still required.
GMS-RAG-001.remediation: Finish cross-tenant RAG cases and route-level retrieval isolation tests.

GMS-RAG-002.finding: The offline benchmark requires human semantic support and abstention review, but live reviewed results are not complete.
GMS-RAG-002.remediation: Complete the 120-case reviewed production RAG scorecard.

GMS-RAG-003.finding: Source re-fetch and revision thinking exist, but every derived/vector path, including optional FAISS, needs verified deletion/replacement propagation.
GMS-RAG-003.remediation: Add source replace/delete regression across pgvector, caches and any enabled auxiliary index.

GMS-PRIV-001.finding: Primary/storage cleanup mechanisms exist, but full deletion/export behavior across derived AI artifacts/providers has not been proven.
GMS-PRIV-001.remediation: Define retention and implement end-to-end deletion/export verification.

GMS-PRIV-002.finding: Studigo targets learners including minors; public child-use consent/guardian/data-minimization requirements are not yet a verified release gate.
GMS-PRIV-002.remediation: Complete privacy/legal/product review for target markets and implement resulting onboarding/consent/retention controls.

GMS-PRIV-003.finding: Direct OpenAI Responses calls now send store:false. Gateway/Ollama transports unchanged; no vendor data-flow register, DPA or org-level retention evidence yet.
GMS-PRIV-003.remediation: Create vendor data-flow register and capture provider configuration evidence.

GMS-LOG-001.finding: No unified security event/alerting control was verified.
GMS-LOG-001.remediation: Define security event taxonomy and implement protected logging/alerts for auth, authorization, abuse, privileged failures and AI-security anomalies.

GMS-LOG-002.finding: A production telemetry/log sampling audit has not verified absence of raw private documents, learner answers, tokens or secrets.
GMS-LOG-002.remediation: Audit logs/telemetry payloads and enforce redaction/minimization.

GMS-SUPPLY-001.finding: All "latest" specifiers pinned to lockfile versions; next 16.3.4 -> 16.3.8 (critical GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j); sharp/source-map-js overridden. CI changed to --frozen-lockfile with pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high (exits 0 locally). One moderate advisory remains (sprintf-js via mammoth CLI parser, no patch, not reachable).
GMS-SUPPLY-001.remediation: Confirm the CI audit step runs on main; add Dependabot/Renovate security updates.
GMS-SUPPLY-001.notes: Becomes pass once CI runs the frozen-lockfile install and audit gate on main. See implementation/SECURITY_AUDIT_CHECKLIST.md.

GMS-SUPPLY-002.finding: No repository secret-scanning gate was found in CI.
GMS-SUPPLY-002.remediation: Enable platform secret scanning and/or CI scanner; document credential rotation response.

GMS-SUPPLY-003.finding: No release SBOM/dependency inventory artifact was verified.
GMS-SUPPLY-003.remediation: Generate and retain an SBOM or equivalent dependency inventory for production releases.

GMS-CI-001.finding: GitHub main branch is currently unprotected and required status checks are not enforced at the branch level.
GMS-CI-001.remediation: Protect main with required PR/review/check rules and prevent bypass except controlled emergency process.

GMS-OPS-001.finding: No complete security/AI incident response and credential rotation runbook was verified.
GMS-OPS-001.remediation: Create incident runbook and perform tabletop for cross-tenant disclosure and AI-cost abuse.

GMS-OPS-002.finding: Backup/restore behavior and interaction with deletion/retention have not been verified in this audit.
GMS-OPS-002.remediation: Document backup model and execute representative restore/deletion tests.
